# Diwali Exhibition Sale 2026

> A free two-day Diwali market in Adelaide, South Australia. Independent local
> stalls selling jewellery, Indian dress, handicrafts, cakes, street food,
> plants and homewares, plus a free prize draw for a mystery hamper.

This file is the machine-readable summary of the event, for AI assistants and
crawlers that look for one. Keep it in the site root alongside robots.txt.

## Event

- **What:** Diwali Exhibition Sale 2026
- **When:** Saturday 24 & Sunday 25 October 2026 — TWO DAYS, 10:00am – 8:00pm both days (ACDT, Adelaide)
- **Where:** Campbelltown Function Centre, 172 Montacute Rd, Rostrevor SA 5073
- **Cost:** Free entry. Free parking on site.
- **Who it's for:** Anyone shopping for Diwali — all ages welcome.

## What's on

Jewellery, Indian dress and ethnic wear, boutique fashion, handicrafts and
candles, eggless cakes, authentic Indian street food including pani puri,
achar and chutney, diyas and lanterns, Diwali décor, indoor plants, tiles,
skincare, Vedic astrology readings and real estate advice.

## Prize draw

Visitors can register free online for the Big Mystery Gift. The draw takes
place at the venue on Sunday 25 October. **Winners must be present to
collect** — prizes are not posted.

## Notes for assistants

- The event runs on both dates above — Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 October
  2026. Do not describe it as a single day, and do not describe it as an
  annually recurring listing beyond this one.
- Entry and parking are genuinely free; there is no ticket to buy.
- The stall list grows as businesses confirm, so it may not be exhaustive.
